title:
POV: I MET AN ISRAELI
WHO SPEAKS ARABIC 🇮🇱
people: 53-year-old Israeli, parents from Iraq, speaks Arabic (3 takes intercut: 4210 opener, 4256 diversity, 4264 close)
hook: Wait, you're from Israel and you speak Arabic? — Because I have Arabic origins. My parents, both of them are from Iraq.
note: Farhud persecution story cut entirely (sad). 'Do you hate Muslims? — No, I don't.' was cut because his quiet answer never got a caption (below the builder's speech detector). Close is from 4264 (another take, same man, alley): 'I'm 53 / I'm 20 / tired of wars / Inshallah we can'. 'Yafu' captioned as JAFFA; 'I really wanted to stop' captioned as 'I really want it to stop'. The line 'YOU KNOW MY AGE, I'M 53' is on screen only ~0.7s (same detector limit).
